facts.text: Bates operates on a 4-4-1 academic calendar featuring a four-week spring Short Term in May where students enroll in a single intensive course.

sources.title: What is Short Term? | Academics | Bates College
sources.quote: Short Term at Bates — four weeks at the height of Maine's spring, from late April through May — is a time for intense, focused work. You'll live and breathe one class, and one class only.
